title: The Network of Intent · Why read this book?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What changes when networks can coordinate around human intent?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This investment thesis explores a network of agents representing personal and organizational intentions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It examines discovery problems in hiring, investment, research collaboration, and local services.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Chapters investigate reciprocal qualification, evidence exchange, negotiation, and contextual reputation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed infrastructure raises questions about privacy, fraud, decentralization, and human approval.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Product and market discussions consider early adoption, operational demands, and network economics.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central tension concerns effective representation without surrendering judgment or control.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This invitation is for readers thinking about agents, coordination, digital markets, and human goals.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read The Network of Intent to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
